|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">ハーチェク・カル・ファスはダークティル出身のサウリン男性で、典型的なドロイド商人だ。買い得なドロイドを探して“闇市場”をうろついている。護衛についているのは従姉妹のサイトア。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Saurin.

'''Card text:'''
At any time, you may use 1 Force to remove (lose) one Restraining Bolt at the same location card. If “protected” by Sai'torr Kal Fas, power is +1 more.

'''Lore:'''
Hrchek Kal Fas is a male Saurin from Durkteel and a typical droid trader. He prowls the “invisible market” for bargain droids. His cousin Sai'torr guards him.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese uses 行動抑制ボルト for Restraining Bolt and ダークティル for Durkteel.
